title: Cinema optical rack-focus across three depth planes
blurb: Composite three overlapping HTML depth planes on one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas with golden-angle disc bokeh, cinema focus breathing and clickable controls on every plane.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas composite three overlapping drawable HTML planes with variable-aperture golden-angle disc bokeh, cinema focus breathing and live hit testing as focus racks between far, mid and near?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412x915 DPR 2.625 and 1040x900 DPR 1): 6/6 live checks pass on one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas (0.98 MP mobile, 0.38 MP desktop, 0 errors, CLS 0), golden-angle disc bokeh shifts far-plane 10 px spill from 189 at f/1.4 to 7 at f/11 while keeping sharp focal edge contrast at 248, and updateElementGeometry() keeps all three overlapping planes clickable. Real Android Chrome 159 and check:jank stay not verified.
